column1: # Rows of the cross-OS benchmark, read by tests/compare/os_bench.sh and
# A field written `-` is empty (consecutive tabs would collapse in a shell
# os           both | linux | windows: the drivers that run the row.  The
#              Windows driver runs a windows row only with -DefenderExcluded
#              and the ram rows only with -RamRoot (a RAM disk).
# kind         library (in-memory render) | deskew (in-memory deskew alone)
# threads      worker count; 1 pins to logical CPU 2, otherwise CPUs
# dpi          render resolution; a process row with sink none ignores it.
# sink         disk (--no-ram and a path prefix) | ram (--ram-path) | none.
# invocations  child runs averaged into one sample; `-` is 1.
# extra        process: rrocket arguments; library: harness flags, where
# Rows of the avx2 group also run on the build with the AVX2 tiers reverted,
# as ROW-pre.  Rows of the gpu group run on the GPU-feature build.
